title: A full $p^{4r}$ supercongruence tower for a level-three symmetric-cube hypergeometric sequence
summary: Let ${}_2F_1(1/3,1/3;1;27z)^3=\sum_{n\ge0}A_nz^n$. We prove the full prime-power supercongruence tower $A_{mp^r}\equiv A_{mp^{r-1}}\pmod{p^{4r}}$ for $p\ge5$, $m\ge1$, $r\ge1$. The level-three modular expansion used below was already recorded by Moy; the contribution here is the depth-preserving modulus $p^{4r}$, extending the previously known depth-one modulus $p^4$ case to all prime powers.
